summary: 3D construction-physics puzzle about building Ottoman mosques, built by Claude Fable 5.1 · Osmanlı camileri inşa ettiğin 3D yapı fiziği bulmacası, Claude Fable 5.1 yaptı
key_features: A masonry simulation written from scratch: thrust vectors, self-weight and the middle-third rule decide whether each pier stands
Sinan's lessons as real solutions: half-domes, weight towers, hidden and stepped buttresses, an octagon of eight piers
15 commissions in 3 periods, up to Süleymaniye and Selimiye, with stone budgets, open windows, minarets and earthquake tests
Live stress colours, thrust-line view, hints from each commission's reference solution and collapses you can watch
The ?auto bot cleared 15/15 commissions with 45/45 stars; node test-levels.js verifies all 15 reference solutions; one index.html, everything generated in code

social.headline: Build Sinan's mosques, pull the scaffolding and let the thrust lines decide · Sinan'ın camilerini kur, iskeleyi kaldır, itki çizgileri karar versin

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository; editorial fields hand-written from the README and index.html; no field is generated from a guess
